cases.name: help_real_horizon_binary
cases.log:
r36_compare_runner --manifest pairs.tsv --sdk-config full.json --method original|stereo
  --output NEW_DIRECTORY --width 640 --height 544 --fx N --fy N --cx N --cy N --bxf FX_TIMES_BASELINE_MM
  [--model stereo.bin] [--det-model det.bin] [--seg-model seg.bin] [--warmup 5] [--repeat 3] [--save-every 10]
Manifest: five TSV columns, no header: stem left_nv12 left_bgr_png right_bgr_png original_q8_raw.
warmup cycles the first N dataset frames; repeat measures complete dataset N times.
save-every 0 disables files; N saves measured ordinal 0,N,2N,... in both methods.
Resource metrics are Linux process CPU time and VmRSS; peak RSS is process-lifetime high-water mark.
This binary supports real Horizon stereo and recorded original Q8.
